title: Go Assembly and Compiler Directives knowledge check

questions.prompt: Which topic is explicitly covered in “Go Assembly and Compiler Directives”?
questions.explanation: The supplied Go curriculum lists “Assembly language overview” under “Go Assembly and Compiler Directives”. The lesson uses that topic as the entry point for the example and practice task.

questions.prompt: Which result should you expect from the example for “Go Assembly and Compiler Directives”, subject to the stated prerequisites?
options: The feature is isolated, version-gated, documented, and validated on the intended target; unsuppo...

questions.prompt: If your go assembly and compiler directives example behaves unexpectedly, what is the best next step?
options: Reduce the issue to a small reproducible case, check inputs and errors, then change one cause and retest.
Suppress all errors so the program appears to succeed.

questions.answer_key: Reduce the issue to a small reproducible case, check inputs and errors, then change one cause and retest.
questions.explanation: A small reproducible case helps separate input mistakes, language semantics, toolchain differences, and external failures. Change one suspected cause and retest.
